title: Psychical Research
creator: Barrett, W. F. (William Fletcher) — Tilford reading edition
basis: W. F. Barrett's Psychical Research (Home University Library, 1911), worked from the Internet Archive scan (psychicalresear00barr). The source file was raw OCR; it has been corrected line by line against the scan, with running headers, page numbers, printer's signature marks and scanner noise removed. Spelling and wording follow the 1911 printing, including its period spellings; any passage that could not be verified against the scan is marked [unverified].
